folds.heading: ## Primitive-use reconciliation B135, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full P1–P27/grep/RNG/schema maps/X1–X15/Q1–Q7 read. Preserve registry versus state, pure preview versus paid command, event outcome versus actual discovery, positive capabilities versus signed costs, observed/practiced/executable method, scenario-only snapshot versus whole-life restoration, and actual reset policy versus descriptive retain strings. Carrier kinds in a preview do not implement every priced journey or cross-world custody path. Existing precomputed household events are private inputs, not permission to show future deaths or family facts without an actual foresight means. P5’s table-level purity label is qualified by [ReaderD B134](D_risk_and_purity.md#purity-report-reconciliation-b134-2026-11-04): unenrolled original-state receivers were not exercised.

Several absence rows are superseded at named source seams. B132 independently inspected actual card/state/module/action and heir calls/carry. Current seeded_streams has peekStreamDecision and armStreamCall; selected peek respects saved overrides/pending calls before returning its keyed decision. A call changes owning state and is not a free projection. Current native combat/location import named streams, and encounter composition uses a keyed encounter cursor. Thus no exported peek, no cheat owner/status and all native combat/randomness outside seeded control are no longer blanket facts. This does not prove all native subsystems, generic future simulation, every active dispatcher, or current browser behavior. Other old X/P absence or schema numbers remain dated until their actual selected owner is checked.

Q1/Q2/Q3 can use both deterministic/independent forecasts and different declared restore domains where their world/means supports them. Q4 is ownership by fact/operation, not choosing one universal cheat store that replaces sources, faculties, knowledge or resources. Existing framework reuse must preserve unsupported/unknown scope, exact input/definition/clock/stream identity and actual consumer. One authored trial’s two rewinds, claim, source count, year or action cap is a local fixture, not a permanent all-world limit. Current AD32/AD38/AD42/AD51 in [RULES_INDEX](../../../RULES_INDEX.md) and [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md) govern proposal status, optional human review and shared seams. No implementation, schema registration, source acquisition, new test pass or native prediction was produced.
